name: When should I consider professional restoration for my rental property?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider professional restoration for my rental property?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider professional restoration when damages go beyond minor wear and tear, or when preparing a property for a new tenant requires more than basic cleaning and cosmetic touch-ups. This includes significant damage from previous tenants, water or fire damage, mold remediation, or if you aim to upgrade the property to attract higher-paying tenants. Professionals ensure quality work and adherence to local building codes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider professional restoration for significant damage, major upgrades, or when preparing a property for new tenants requires more than minor fixes.
